# Descriptions
@@ 1
This spell allows the caster to march (moving at double normal base rate),
with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops, the spell is
cancelled.
@@ 2
This spell reduces the difficulty of riding maneuvers by 3 categories for the
duration of the spell (e.g., Very Hard (-20) becomes Light (+10)). If the
caster dismounts, the spell is cancelled.
@@ 3
This spell allows the caster to swim at base movement rate, with no exhaustion
points spent, for the duration. If he stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.
@@ 4
This spell allows the caster’s steed to move at double its base rate, with no
exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If the steed stops, the spell is
cancelled.
@@ 5
The caster may march at normal speed for the duration of this spell without
making any sound. This will provide a special bonus of +10 to +50 to any
Stalking maneuvers (GM discretion). If the caster stops marching, the spell is
cancelled.
@@ 6
This spell allows the caster to swim at double his normal rate (i.e., as fast
as he can run), with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops
swimming, the spell is cancelled.
@@ 7
This spell reduces the difficulty of moving maneuvers by 3 categories for the
duration of the spell (e.g., Very Hard (-20) becomes Light (+10)). This spell
can only assist with maneuvers made in in the same round as an attack is
declared.
@@ 8
The caster’s steed may move at its base movement rate for the duration of this
spell with neither the caster nor the steed making any sound. If the caster
dismounts this spell is cancelled.
@@ 9
This spell allows the caster to fly at a rate of 50' per round (about 3 mph)
for the duration of the spell. If the caster stops flying, the spell is
cancelled.
@@ 10
With this spell a caster can move one target a distance of 5' per level (of
the caster) instantly. There can be intervening barriers if the caster
specifies exact distances. If the arrival point coincides with solid or liquid
material, the target does not move; instead, he is stunned d10 rounds (the
caster still expends the PPs for this spell). A barrier is defined as anything
the target could not physically go through without manipulating an object
(e.g., a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).
@@ 11
As Forced March, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 12
As Riding, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 13
As Swimming I, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 14
As Forced Ride, except caster can affect one steed per level.
@@ 15
As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 3 targets a distance of 15' per
level instantly.
@@ 16
As Silent March, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 17
As Swimming II, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 18
As Battle Maneuver, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 19
As Silent Ride, except caster can affect one steed and rider per level.
@@ 20
As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 5 targets a distance of 25' per
level instantly.
@@ 25
As Flight, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 30
As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 10 targets a distance of 50' per
level instantly.
@@ 50
As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 1 target per level of the caster
a distance of 100' per level instantly.
